battle.name: 俄羅斯入侵烏克蘭
battle.brief: 俄羅斯入侵烏克蘭自2022年2月展開，戰線由北、東、南多個方向推進，地面作戰結合裝甲突擊與遠程火力打擊。俄軍使用T-72B主戰坦克執行地面進攻；此型號於1985年服役，是俄羅斯地面部隊的制式裝備，任務包括突破防線、伴隨步兵推進及提供機動火力支援。

kit.name: 主戰坦克
kit.history: T-72B是俄羅斯地面部隊的主戰坦克，位於裝甲作戰核心，負責突破防線、護送步兵及提供機動火力，並與自走榴彈砲協同作戰。

countries: 這場2022年俄羅斯入侵烏克蘭的地面交戰，主體是俄羅斯聯邦武裝部隊與烏克蘭武裝部隊；俄方還由頓涅茨克、盧甘斯克地方武裝參與作戰。白俄羅斯提供軍用機場、鐵路、公路與住宿基地，但未投入本身的師級地面部隊，因此不列作主要地面交戰者。戰線分成北方、東部與南方：北方集群由白俄羅斯邊境、蘇梅及切爾尼戈夫方向逼近基輔；東部集群由羅斯托夫、沃羅涅日和頓涅茨克向哈爾科夫、伊久姆及庫皮揚斯克施壓；南方集群以俄方控制的克里米亞為基地，攻向赫爾松、扎波羅熱、頓涅茨克南部及亞速海沿岸。北約、歐盟及若干國家提供武器、訓練、情報與財政支持，但沒有以國家身分加入地面戰鬥；摩爾多瓦也未成為主要戰場。
countriesEn: The principal ground belligerents in Russia’s 2022 invasion of Ukraine were the armed forces of the Russian Federation and Ukraine, with the local forces of Donetsk and Luhansk also participating on the Russian side. Belarus provided military airfields, railways, roads, and accommodation bases, but it did not commit its own army-sized ground formations and is therefore not treated as a principal ground belligerent. The front was divided into northern, eastern, and southern sectors. The northern grouping advanced toward Kyiv from the Belarusian border and through Sumy and Chernihiv. The eastern grouping applied pressure toward Kharkiv, Izium, and Kupyansk from Rostov, Voronezh, and Donetsk. The southern grouping used Russian-controlled Crimea as a base for operations toward Kherson, Zaporizhzhia, southern Donetsk, and the Sea of Azov coast. NATO, the European Union, and several other states supplied weapons, training, intelligence, and financial support without entering ground combat as belligerents. Moldova was not a principal battlefield.
people: 俄方的政治決策、戰略目標與動員命令由弗拉基米爾·普京主持，安德烈·別伊負責國防部協調，瓦西里·祖利奇及總參謀部處理軍種與後勤問題。地面指揮先後由亞歷山大·多沃爾尼科夫及瓦列里·蘇羅維金負責；蘇羅維金於2022年5月下旬獲得烏克蘭戰區聯合部隊的指揮責任。主要作戰單位包括近衛第1坦克軍、第2、第3、第4、第5、第6、第7及第8合成軍，以及第58、第47、第49、第8和第51軍。烏克蘭方面，澤連斯基負責最高政治與對外協調，瓦列里·扎盧日尼擔任武裝部隊總司令，國防部與總參謀部策劃全國防務；第93、第128、第80、第72、第24及第30机械化旅等部隊在哈爾科夫、頓巴斯和南方戰線輪換作戰。丹尼斯·普希林與列奧尼德·帕謝奇尼克是頓涅茨克、盧甘斯克地方政權的政治領袖，葉夫根尼·普里戈津則率領瓦格納組織，該組織在索萊達爾及巴赫穆特方向保持較高作戰自主性，也與俄軍正式指揮系統多次發生摩擦。
peopleEn: Strategic political decisions, war aims, and mobilization orders in Russia were directed by Vladimir Putin. Andrey Shoigu coordinated the Ministry of Defence, while Valery Gerasimov and the General Staff handled service and logistics matters. Operational land command passed through Alexander Dvornikov and Valery Surovikin, with Surovikin receiving responsibility for the combined force grouping in Ukraine in late May 2022. The principal Russian formations included the 1st Guards Tank Army, the 2nd, 3rd, 4th, 5th, 6th, 7th, and 8th Combined Arms Armies, and the 58th, 47th, 49th, 8th, and 51st Armies. In Ukraine, Zelensky directed high-level political and external coordination, while Commander-in-Chief Valery Zaluzhny led the Armed Forces through the Ministry of Defence and General Staff. Separate brigades including the 93rd, 128th, 80th, 72nd, 24th, and 30th Mechanized Brigades rotated through the Kharkiv, Donbas, and southern fronts. Denis Pushilin and Leonid Pasechnik were the political leaders of the Donetsk and Luhansk administrations. Yevgeny Prigozhin commanded the Wagner organization, which retained substantial operational autonomy around Soledar and Bakhmut and repeatedly came into conflict with Russia’s formal command structure.
kits: 俄軍投入的裝備均在2022年以前列裝，包括T-72B3、T-72B3M、T-90A、BMP-1、BMP-2、BTR-80及BTR-82A。炮兵主力為1989年列裝的2S19、2012年列裝的2S35、2018年列裝的2S34、2S4、9A55Grad、BM-21Grad、9K57BM-27暴風雨及2012年列裝的TOS-1A；常見彈藥包括125公厘穿甲、破甲與制導炮彈，152公厘高爆榴彈，9K55炮彈，9K58 Grad火箭炮彈，以及122與300公厘火箭彈。航空兵力使用MiG-29、MiG-31、Su-27、Su-30SM、Su-35S、Su-24M、Tu-22M3、Tu-95MS、Ka-52及Mi-28N，並使用Kh-101、Kinzhal等已在役的武器。2017年列裝的Lancet與2018年列裝的Orlan-10分別用於攻擊裝甲與戰場監視，R-330Zh及2014年列裝的Pole-21則保護後方指揮所、雷達與彈藥庫。烏克蘭運用T-64BV、T-80UD、T-84U Oplot、BMP-2、BMP-3、BTR-3、BTR-4、2S7、2S9、2018年列裝的2K22及BM-21，並以M777 HSS、1992年列裝的HIMARS、S-300、Buk-M1、Kub-M3、Stinger、Javelin、NLAW及AT4構成火力與防空體系；M777自1988年起服役，Bayraktar TB2則於2014年列裝。雙方都使用前線排障與回收單位處理故障、磨損及繳獲裝備，但能否投入作戰取決於車況、零件、訓練與補給。
kitsEn: The equipment committed by Russia had all entered service before 2022. It included the T-72B3, T-72B3M, T-90A, BMP-1, BMP-2, BTR-80, and BTR-82A. The principal artillery systems were the 2S19, fielded in 1989; the 2S35, fielded in 2012; the 2S34, fielded in 2018; the 2S4; the 9A55 Grad; the BM-21 Grad; the 9K57 BM-27 Uragan; and the TOS-1A, fielded in 2012. Common ammunition included 125 mm armour-piercing, high-explosive, and guided rounds; 152 mm high-explosive shells; 9K55 rounds for the 2S19; 9K58 Grad rockets for the 9A55 and BM-21; and 122 mm and 300 mm rockets. Russian aviation included MiG-29, MiG-31, Su-27, Su-30SM, Su-35S, Su-24M, Tu-22M3, Tu-95MS, Ka-52, and Mi-28N, together with weapons such as the Kh-101 and Kinzhal. The Lancet, fielded in 2017, and Orlan-10, fielded in 2018, were used for attacks against armored vehicles and battlefield observation. The R-330Zh and Pole-21, fielded in 2014, protected command posts, radar stations, and ammunition depots in the rear area. Ukraine used T-64BV, T-80UD, T-84U Oplot, BMP-2, BMP-3, BTR-3, BTR-4, 2S7, 2S9, 2K22, fielded in 2018, and BM-21, while building firepower and air-defence systems around M777 HSS, HIMARS, fielded in 1992, S-300, Buk-M1, Kub-M3, Stinger, Javelin, NLAW, and AT4. The M777 had entered service in 1988, while Bayraktar TB2 was fielded in 2014. Both sides used frontline recovery and maintenance units to address damage, wear, and captured equipment, but whether such equipment could be employed depended on its condition, spare parts, crew training, and resupply.
tactics: 2022年2月24日，俄軍同時展開北方、東北部與南方進攻。北方集群從白俄羅斯向基輔、速向切爾尼戈夫與蘇梅推進，傘兵及直升機部隊在霍斯托梅爾、瓦西爾基夫與查伊卡一帶著陸，企圖控制重要機場並切斷基輔方向的道路；北線因道路壅塞、補給拉長、部隊分散及指揮失靈而未能在基輔城下形成持續攻勢。東北部集群由別爾戈羅羅德、沃羅涅日及羅斯托夫方向進攻哈爾科夫與盧甘斯克，但未能完成伊久姆至庫皮揚斯克的鉗形合圍。南方集群從克里米亞越過克里米亞地峽，向赫爾松及扎波羅熱擴張，2月26日控制梅利托波爾、2月底控制別爾迪揚斯克、3月初進入埃涅爾戈達爾，並以長時間圍攻拿下馬里烏波爾及亞速鋼鐵廠一帶。4月18日，俄軍在頓巴斯重啟固定方向攻勢，至5月下旬把主要戰場推向北頓尼茨克與北盧甘斯克，6月底控制北頓尼茨克，7月17日控制萊先昌斯克。9月初，烏克蘭利用俄軍從北方及東北方向抽調部隊造成的空隙，在哈爾科夫州反擊，9月10日奪回利曼，9月中旬進入庫皮揚斯克，但未立即完全控制該市。俄軍9月21日宣布徵召，9月30日簽署部分動員命令，新编成部隊其後被投入庫皮揚斯克及北頓涅茨克方向；多支部隊缺乏完整裝甲、炮兵協同與系統訓練，因此仍高度依賴炮兵、兵役人員與後方射擊支援。Lancet及Orlan-10分別用於反裝甲攻擊和炮兵座標偵察，Kh-101、Kinzhal、無人飛行器與彈道飛彈則打擊鐵路、彈藥庫、機場及指揮節點。到11月底，俄軍放棄部分哈爾科夫突出部與赫爾松西岸，退往較易防守的地帶，並在北頓涅茨克至扎波羅熱方向趕建蘇羅維金防線，但整場戰役仍停留在流動戰與陣地戰交替的階段。
tacticsEn: On 24 February 2022, Russia launched attacks across the northern, northeastern, and southern sectors. The northern grouping advanced from Belarus toward Kyiv and toward Chernihiv and Sumy. Airborne and helicopter forces landed around Hostomel, Vasylkiv, and Chaika to seize airfields and disrupt roads leading to Kyiv. The northern offensive failed to generate sustained pressure against Kyiv because of road congestion, stretched supply lines, dispersed formations, and command failures. The northeastern grouping attacked Kharkiv and Luhansk from the Belgorod, Voronezh, and Rostov directions but did not close the pincer between Izium and Kupyansk. The southern grouping crossed the Crimean Isthmus from Crimea toward Kherson and Zaporizhzhia. It took Melitopol on 26 February, Berdyansk near the end of February, and Enerhodar in early March, then spent months seizing Mariupol and the Azovstal area. On 18 April, Russia renewed its fixed-axis offensive in Donbas. By late May the principal battles had shifted to Severodonetsk and northern Luhansk; Russia took Severodonetsk by the end of June and Lysychansk on 17 July. In early September, Ukraine exploited the redeployment of Russian formations from the north and northeast by counterattacking in Kharkiv Oblast. Ukrainian forces retook Lyman on 10 September and entered Kupyansk in mid-September without immediately gaining full control of the city. Russia announced conscription on 21 September and signed the partial-mobilization decree on 30 September. The resulting formations were committed to the Kupyansk and northern Donetsk sectors. Many lacked integrated armour, artillery support, and systematic training, so they remained heavily dependent on artillery, conscripted personnel, and rear-area fire support. Lancet and Orlan-10 were used for anti-armour attacks and artillery reconnaissance, while Kh-101, Kinzhal, unmanned aircraft, and ballistic missiles struck railways, ammunition depots, airfields, and command nodes. By late November, Russian forces had relinquished parts of the Kharkiv salient and most of the western bank at Kherson, moved into more defensible positions, and accelerated construction of the Surovikin defensive line from northern Donetsk toward Zaporizhzhia, although the campaign continued to alternate between maneuver warfare and positional operations.
data: 美國情報總監辦公室在2022年2月18日估算，俄軍在烏克蘭周邊集結超過169,000名人員，較1月30日所評估的約100,000人增加；同一評估列出3,894輛戰鬥車、491套火炮系統、370架固定翼飛機及60架直升機。這是部署估計，不是開戰時完整編制。時間線顯示，2月24日全面進攻開始，2月26日梅利托波爾淪陷，4月18日頓巴斯固定方向攻勢展開，5月下旬北頓尼茨克成為主戰場，7月17日萊先昌斯克失守，9月初烏克蘭在哈爾科夫州反攻，9月10日利曼失而復得，9月17日烏軍宣布進入庫皮揚斯克。赫爾松撤退命令於11月11日發出，俄方在11月20日宣布撤軍完成，烏方則確認西岸主要市區已撤空；9月30日的部分動員令在11月30日以停止徵召的命令作結。12月31日，普京下令從扎波羅熱州部分地區撤軍，但年內沒有獨立核實全部完成。聯合國人权监测團在11月24日核實了一次交換，涉及802名被俘人員及34名受傷軍人。各階段死亡、受傷、失蹤及被俘數字因確認方式、統計時點與分類規則不同，無法可靠拼成單一總數，因此本實錄不採用任何未經核實的精確傷亡總表。
dataEn: On 18 February 2022, the United States Office of the Director of National Intelligence estimated that Russia had massed more than 169,000 personnel near Ukraine, up from about 100,000 on 30 January. The same assessment listed 3,894 combat vehicles, 491 artillery systems, 370 fixed-wing aircraft, and 60 helicopters. These were deployment estimates rather than a complete wartime order of battle. The chronology records the full-scale invasion on 24 February, the fall of Melitopol on 26 February, the fixed-axis Donbas offensive launched on 18 April, the emergence of Severodonetsk as the main battlefield in late May, the fall of Lysychansk on 17 July, the Ukrainian counteroffensive in Kharkiv Oblast in early September, the recapture of Lyman on 10 September, and Ukraine’s announcement that it had entered Kupyansk on 17 September. The order to withdraw from Kherson was issued on 11 November; Russia announced completion on 20 November, while Ukraine confirmed that the main urban area west of the Dnieper had been vacated. The 30 September partial-mobilization decree was concluded by an order ending conscription on 30 November. On 31 December, Putin ordered the withdrawal of Russian forces from parts of Zaporizhzhia Oblast, although there was no independent confirmation that this withdrawal had been completed within 2022. On 24 November, the United Nations human-rights monitoring mission verified an exchange involving 802 prisoners of war and 34 wounded service members. Reported deaths, injuries, missing personnel, and prisoners differed across stages because verification methods, reporting dates, and classification rules were not consistent. A single reliable casualty total therefore cannot be assembled, and this record does not use any unverified precision casualty total.
cause: 直接背景可分成_structural與政治層次。2014年，俄羅斯兼併克里米亞並支持頓涅茨克、盧甘斯克地方武裝，烏克蘭的領土完整與邊境安全從此成為長期爭議；2015年的明斯克協議建立了停火框架，但沒有解決實際控制與全面撤軍問題，部分地區仍持續戰鬥。俄羅斯自2021年起在烏克蘭邊境增加兵員，2022年初美國情報機構評估其正在準備大規模攻勢。2月21日至22日，普京承認兩個地方政權並主張其對烏克蘭相關地區的主權，2月23日發表講話並下令展開特別軍事行動，成為全面入侵的政治與軍事觸發點。俄羅斯公開提出的要求包括烏克蘭從頓巴斯全面撤軍、限制北約在烏境內的軍事存在及由北約提供新的安全保證；基輔拒絕以割讓主權、承認佔領或放棄防衛合作來換取停火。烏克蘭自2014年後確實重建軍力，北約也在2019年承諾加入程序，但公開情報並未建立烏克蘭準備立即攻擊俄羅斯或北約基地的可靠時間表。北約國家沒有直接參戰，烏克蘭也沒有被證實在2022年2月先發動全面進攻，因此近因是俄羅斯作出的進攻決定，而不是已發生的北約交戰或烏克蘭先攻。
causeEn: The immediate background can be divided into structural and political causes. In 2014, Russia annexed Crimea and supported the local forces in Donetsk and Luhansk, making Ukrainian territorial integrity and border security continuing sources of dispute. The 2015 Minsk agreements established a ceasefire framework but did not resolve territorial control or a complete troop withdrawal, and fighting continued in some areas. Russia increased troop numbers along Ukraine’s borders from 2021, and in early 2022 United States intelligence assessed preparations for a large offensive. On 21 and 22 February, Putin recognized the two separatist administrations and asserted sovereignty over the relevant Ukrainian regions; on 23 February he delivered an address and ordered the launch of the special military operation, creating the political and military trigger for the full-scale invasion. Russia publicly demanded a complete Ukrainian withdrawal from Donbas, restrictions on NATO military presence in Ukraine, and new NATO security guarantees. Kyiv rejected a ceasefire based on ceding sovereignty, recognizing occupation, or abandoning defence cooperation. Ukraine had genuinely rebuilt its armed forces since 2014, and NATO had granted an accession roadmap in 2019, but open-source intelligence did not establish a reliable timetable showing that Ukraine planned an immediate attack on Russia or NATO bases. NATO states did not enter the war, and Ukraine was not verified as having launched the full-scale invasion first. The proximate cause was therefore Russia’s decision to attack, rather than an existing NATO war or an established Ukrainian first strike.
impact: 作戰層面上，北方速戰速決計劃受挫，暴露了俄軍長距離縱隊、燃料供應、指揮通信及後勤規劃的限制；南方戰線較快取得進展，卻沒有消除北頓尼茨克與馬里烏波爾的長期消耗戰。到秋季，主動權主要集中於頓巴斯，俄軍增加炮兵、徵召部隊與遠程打擊，依賴固定火力支援及大量被動承受衝擊的營級進攻。俄羅斯工業動員雖擴大了炮彈與飛彈供應，庫存、炮管壽命和裝備補充仍形成持續負擔；烏克蘭則利用縱深防禦、反炮兵偵察、無人飛行器、M777 HSS、HIMARS、Javelin等武器維持重點方向的反擊能力，外部防空系統也降低了俄軍航空與巡航飛彈的威脅。黑海方面，Moscow號巡洋艦於3月17日被擊沉，烏軍於9月底收復蛇島，克里米亞港口、軍用機場及補給節點持續遭打擊；連接克里米亞與羅斯托夫的克里米亞大橋公路部分於10月19日重新開放，增加了南部運輸選項，但未能取代整個鐵路與公路補給網。瓦格納組織6月23日至24日拒絕俄軍指揮系統並短暫占領總參謀部大樓所在區域，迫使克里姆林宮重新協商其指揮關係，該組織其後返回前線。政治層面上，2月3日聯合國大會第ES-11/1號決議譴責侵略，多數會員國拒絕承認俄羅斯9月兼併四州的法律效果，北約與歐盟則持續提供軍援和制裁。遠程打擊提高了雙方後方成本，但沒有切斷烏克蘭的指揮、替補與城市補給，也沒有迫使基輔接受俄方條件。
impactEn: Operationally, the collapse of the northern blitzkrieg plan exposed weaknesses in Russian long columns, fuel supply, command communications, and logistics planning. The southern front made faster gains but did not eliminate the attritional fighting in northern Donetsk and Mariupol. By autumn, initiative was concentrated mainly in Donbas, where Russia relied on heavier artillery use, mobilized formations, long-range strikes, and infantry attacks that often absorbed impacts through mass rather than mobility. Russia’s industrial mobilization expanded artillery and missile output, but stocks, barrel life, and equipment replacement remained continuing strains. Ukraine used defense in depth, counter-battery reconnaissance, drones, M777 HSS, HIMARS, Javelin, and other weapons to sustain counterattacks in selected sectors, while imported air-defence systems reduced the threat from Russian aircraft and cruise missiles. In the Black Sea, the cruiser Moskva was sunk on 17 March, Ukraine recaptured Snake Island at the end of September, and military airfields, ports, and supply nodes in Crimea continued to come under attack. The road section of the Crimean Bridge reopened on 19 October, adding a transport option for the southern theater but not replacing the railway and road network. Between 23 and 24 June, Wagner refused the Russian command chain and briefly occupied the area around the General Staff headquarters, forcing the Kremlin to renegotiate its command relationship before Wagner returned to the front. Politically, United Nations General Assembly Resolution ES-11/1 condemned the aggression on 3 March, most member states refused to recognize the legal effect of Russia’s September annexation of four oblasts, and NATO and the European Union continued military support and sanctions. Long-range strikes increased rear-area costs but did not sever Ukrainian command, replacement, and urban supply systems or compel Kyiv to accept Russian conditions.
result: 截至2022年12月31日，俄羅斯沒有奪取基輔、蘇梅、切爾尼戈夫、哈爾科夫或敖德薩，北方集群未能進入基輔市中心作持續控制，北東部的伊久姆至庫皮揚斯克合圍也沒有形成；南方集群雖取得梅利托波爾、馬里烏波爾、克里米亞及部分扎波羅熱地區，卻未建立跨越烏克蘭全國的連續控制線。烏克蘭仍保有基輔、哈爾科夫、第聶伯羅彼得羅夫斯克、扎波羅熱、敖德薩及尼古拉耶夫等主要城市，也控制赫爾松西岸；俄方則繼續控制克里米亞、亞速海部分海岸，以及盧甘斯克、頓涅茨克、扎波羅熱和哈爾科夫州的部分地區，但沒有控制這四州全部領土。9月撤出哈爾科夫州北部部分突出部、11月撤出赫爾松西岸，是具有明確戰術意義的撤退，卻不等於俄方放棄整場入侵或所有既有控制區。部分動員確實增加了俄軍人手，使部分新編部隊能投入北頓尼茨克、庫皮揚斯克與瓦格納方向作戰，但訓練、裝備、補給及指揮整合不足仍限制整體攻勢。到年底，俄軍在北頓涅茨克至扎波羅熱方向推進蘇羅維金防線，烏軍則以縱深陣地、選擇性反擊和局部奪回赫爾松維持防線。因此，2022年的結果不是任何一方取得完整戰略勝利：俄羅斯擴大了2022年2月24日以後在南部與頓巴斯的控制，卻未完成北方速決及全國控制目標；烏克蘭避免了國家與主要城市失守，卻仍未能收復克里米亞及2014年以來被俄方控制的大部分頓涅茨克、盧甘斯克地區。停火、全面撤軍及永久解決領土問題均未達成，軍事衝突在2023年繼續。
resultEn: By 31 December 2022, Russia had not taken Kyiv, Sumy, Chernihiv, Kharkiv, or Odesa. The northern grouping had not gained sustained control of central Kyiv, and the northeastern pincer between Izium and Kupyansk had not formed. The southern grouping had taken Melitopol, Mariupol, Crimea, and parts of Zaporizhzhia Oblast, but it had not established continuous control across Ukraine. Ukraine retained Kyiv, Kharkiv, Dnipro, Zaporizhzhia, Odesa, Mykolaiv, and the western bank of Kherson. Russian and Russian-aligned forces continued to control Crimea, part of the Sea of Azov coast, and areas of Luhansk, Donetsk, Zaporizhzhia, and Kharkiv oblasts, but not the entirety of those four oblasts. The September withdrawal from parts of the northern Kharkiv salient and the November withdrawal from the western bank of Kherson were tactically meaningful retreats, but they did not amount to abandonment of the invasion or every area previously held by Russia. Mobilization did add personnel and allowed newly formed formations to be committed in northern Donetsk, around Kupyansk, and alongside Wagner, but inadequate training, equipment, supply, and command integration continued to constrain Russia’s offensive capability. By the end of the year, Russia was constructing the Surovikin defensive line from northern Donetsk toward Zaporizhzhia, while Ukraine maintained a defense in depth, conducted selective counterattacks, and recovered most of Kherson. The result was therefore not a complete strategic victory for either side. Russia enlarged its control in southern Ukraine and Donbas after 24 February but did not achieve its northern rapid-decision goal or nationwide control. Ukraine prevented the loss of the state and its principal cities but did not recover Crimea or most of the Donetsk and Luhansk territory held by Russia since 2014. No ceasefire, complete withdrawal, or permanent territorial settlement had been achieved, and military operations continued into 2023.
